The Westwood approach

Four services.
Two ways to visit.

PEX open access

For PEX clients, a flexible, shared, self-serve recovery experience. Walk in during flex hours and use up to 60 minutes to create your own routine. The room accommodates up to four people.

Monday–Thursday: 6 AM–6 PM
Friday: 6 AM–4 PM
